Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4689853. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Join activities to assays on assay_id, join activities to compound_structures on molregno, and join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
